primaryText: I thought that your yacht was larger than it is
context: A guest to a touchy yacht owner, on first seeing the yacht.

readings.name: de re: ACTUALLY in the than-clause, consistent thought
de dicto: no ACTUALLY, contradictory thought

comment: Russell's ambiguity: the pair of readings von Stechow derives from presence vs absence of the ACTUALLY operator rather than scope.

primaryText: If Mary had smoked less (than she did), she would be healthier (than she is)

readings.name: informative: than-clauses anchored to the actual world by ACTUALLY
trivial: than-clauses evaluated in the counterfactual world, antecedent and consequent contradictory

comment: Ambiguous counterfactual: only the ACTUALLY-anchored reading is informative.

primaryText: Ede is cleverer than anyone of us
comment: NPI licensed in the than-clause.

primaryText: Max is as well as ever
comment: NPI licensed in the as-phrase.

primaryText: Any of my friends could ever solve these problems faster than Ede
comment: NPIs in the matrix clause, outside the downward-entailing than-clause: unlicensed.

primaryText: Ede could solve these problems faster than any of my friends could ever do
comment: Same NPIs inside the than-clause: licensed.

primaryText: You have already got less support than he has
comment: The PPI already sits in the matrix clause, outside the downward-entailing than-clause: fine.

primaryText: He has got more support than you already have
comment: The PPI already inside the downward-entailing than-clause: excluded.

primaryText: Konstanz is nicer than Düsseldorf or Stuttgart
paperFeatures: Konstanz is nicer than Düsseldorf and Stuttgart
comment: Disjunction in the than-clause entails the conjunctive variant.

primaryText: Ede is fatter than anyone of us
paperFeatures: Ede is fatter than everyone of us
comment: Existential in the than-clause entails the universal variant.

primaryText: Ede is fatter than Max
comment: The unwarranted inference an adequate theory must block.

primaryText: Irene is prettier than neither Ede nor Senta
comment: Negative quantifier in the than-clause; oddness is semantic, not syntactic. Russell: the description fails to denote; Cresswell: a logical falsehood.

primaryText: Irene is prettier than no one of us
comment: Negative quantifier in the than-clause; same diagnosis as (99a).

primaryText: A polar bear could be bigger than a grizzly bear could be
comment: Modal comparative: max possible polar-bear size exceeds max possible grizzly size.

primaryText: More silly lectures have been given by more silly professors than I expected
comment: Multihead comparative; attributed to Chomsky in the paper.

primaryText: John is six inches taller than Mary
comment: Differential reading: inexpressible without degrees, against Klein's degree-free semantics.

primaryText: Ede is twice as fat as Angelika
comment: Factor equative: requires ratio structure on degrees.

primaryText: Ede is more tall than broad
comment: Cross-dimensional comparison: comparison classes for the two adjectives are incommensurable in Klein's system.

primaryText: At least 6 more toads than frogs croak
comment: Comparative determiner over plural nouns; set cardinality serves as the degree.

primaryText: Ede owns at most 3 ounces more gold than Kurt
comment: Comparative over mass nouns; the amount of the totality serves as the degree.

primaryText: Tristan yells three times as loudly as Otto
comment: Factor equative over adverbs; the analysis carries over with an event measure.

primaryText: This pack is at least fifty kilos too heavy to lift
paperFeatures: If one could lift this pack, then it would be at least 50 kg less heavy than it actually is
comment: R13: too as a counterfactual comparative morpheme; the paraphrase is the paper's (229).

primaryText: The weather is too good to stay at home
comment: The infinitival complement of too denotes a proposition, not a property of the subject.
